bootstrap_authority: Explicit local operator CLI only. Pin each exact declared upstream repository/revision pair, use fixed git/make commands and a stripped environment, retain licensing/source identity, inspect compiled artifacts without native execution, install private immutable content-addressed files, and approve exact target subsets atomically. No web installation, BIOS/key download or test/game execution. Optional expansion recipes use exact identified public upstream pins and required submodule commit identities. Source acquisition preserves inherited proxy/CA trust; build subprocesses retain a minimal credential-free environment. Explicit candidate registration does not grant unavailable firmware or GPU features.
scope: Operator-approved installed libretro libraries and bounded exact multi-file game content under the existing Jeeves game-learning owner. Canonical Dragon hardware target identities remain authoritative.
console_integration: Add explicit emulator:<canonical hardware ID> console choices under the existing catalogue/runtime owner. Keep native-source/reference choices separate. All canonical targets receive a truthful entry even where no core is mapped or installed. The isolated host must handle installed_libretro_emulator; unsupported targets fail rather than selecting a reference simulation.

registry.authority: A local operator explicitly approves an installed core path/hash, mapped hardware targets, system directory, configuration and firmware requirements. API requests cannot register libraries or host paths. Empty/unset registry grants no native execution.
registry.atomic_updates: Private advisory operator file lock, atomic replacement and parent directory fsync; explicit removals/approvals only
registry.candidate_approval: Compiled libraries with absent required firmware may be recorded approved:false with exact required filename declarations. Static code/ABI validity cannot activate such a candidate.

inspection: Bounded nonsymlink regular library files, stable inode/size/time identity, exact SHA256, ELF shared-object architecture matching the host and actual exported libretro ABI symbols. Inspection never dlopens a library or runs constructors. Required firmware is presence and exact-byte identity only; no external proprietary firmware/keys are fetched, disclosed or bundled. Actual ABI version/system-info/content loading occurs only in the separately declared isolated emulator host. Complete bounded system directory inventory is hashed, including optional assets and missing optional rows; the host copies every present file and compares the copied inventory digest before native activation.
revalidation: Issued immutable core descriptors bind canonical registry digest, exact library and firmware bytes, target scope and options. The host must revalidate against the current operator registry before commands; changed/withdrawn files or approvals fail closed. A descriptor is not a hardware/game compatibility certificate.

content.authority: Only existing rights-admitted exact source bytes or canonical governed artifact references are normalized. No caller host paths, extraction, URL fetches, code execution or copyright/DRM bypass. materialize_private uses a host-owned reader of governed artifact references, bounded streamed exact hashes/lengths/prefixes, safe private paths and exclusive writes. The isolated worker receives fullpath files or mmap data without multi-gigabyte base64/IPC copies. Authority of the artifact reader remains the existing application owner.
formats: CUE plus exact relative track files
GDI plus exact relative track files
rules: Reject traversal, absolute/drive paths, symlinks, encryption, casefold/NFC aliases, nested archives, unknown ZIP expansion and missing referenced tracks
Preserve actual filenames and each content SHA256; bind ordered dependency graph, entrypoint and complete bundle digest

Descriptor references include bounded actual prefix bytes; small CUE/GDI/M3U descriptors carry their entire digest-validated text. Materialization verifies every prefix and the complete streamed byte hash before admission
CUE/GDI/M3U descriptor syntax and ISO/CHD structure are bounded metadata checks, not compatibility/playability proof
content.opaque_core_archives: load_game_content_for_core revalidates the exact operator-approved core binding. Only the declared DOSBox Pure, FBNeo, MAME 2003 Plus, MAME 2003, MAME 2016 and FBA 2012 Neo Geo core profiles preserve an actual ZIP (plus DOSBox Pure .dosz) as opaque native content; all directory/path/member/count/ratio/expanded-byte/CRC bounds still apply before admission. Worker actual retro_system_info.block_extract must agree before loading; no caller boolean grants this behavior. Large streamed archive descriptors remain exact owned files under the isolated worker resource budget.
content.extension_profiles: Fixed native-content suffix hints are copied from the exact pinned upstream core valid_extensions declarations. They permit data-only metadata admission outside known cartridge parsers only after the existing owner resolves current approved core/target authority. Missing or malformed known cartridge formats do not become opaque. These hints are not native load approval: the isolated worker checks actual loaded core valid_extensions, exact content, and applicable block_extract before admission.

failure: Unknown target, unmapped/absent/unapproved core, malformed manifest, changed SHA/scope, wrong architecture, missing ABI/firmware, unsafe filename/descriptor, exhausted bounds and missing disc dependency fail explicitly. Modern/closed systems remain unavailable unless a declared adapter exists; the target count never implies emulator availability.
qualification: NO TESTS user instruction persists. Static compile/lint/source review only. Actual core compilation/installation and later gameplay are separate operator/product work; no universal commercial-ROM or production-model qualification claim.

two_hour_expansion.scope: Broader actual pinned core compilation and explicit operator installation under the same registry; no automated tests. Firmware/render/dependency failures remain unavailable, not reference emulation.
two_hour_expansion.software_builds: DS scope uses exact upstream FreeBIOS and software renderer, excludes DSi. N64 scope pins Angrylion/pure interpreter and disables threaded rendering. PSP scope requests software fallback with upstream public assets; missing dependency/render/firmware capabilities fail explicitly.
two_hour_expansion.system_assets: Only public artifacts already in the exact pinned source tree may be copied under an explicit recipe, bounded1024 files/64MiB and immutable exact SHA256. Retained upstream licenses do not grant ROM or commercial-use rights.
two_hour_expansion.operator_dependencies: Build-only header paths and OpenGL library paths may be supplied explicitly through the local CLI. Installed dependency bytes are observed and recorded; the command does not fetch/install dependencies or enable hardware rendering. Actual isolated runtime admission remains separate.
two_hour_expansion.inactive_gpu_scope: Flycast can be compiled/inspected under an exact pinned recipe but is registered approved:false because the isolated host has no approved hardware rendering context. Compilation does not imply Dreamcast gameplay availability.
two_hour_expansion.license_aliases: An upstream license symlink may be resolved only to a nonsymlink regular file inside the exact pinned source root. Copy its actual text under an immutable regular destination and record the source alias/target; external targets and unsafe installed-library paths remain rejected.
two_hour_expansion.static_compilation_scope: 34 ELF libretro core libraries built locally at this wave end, including28 additional.29 operator-approved mappings cover46 canonical hardware targets; 4 firmware-missing candidates and1 hardware-rendering candidate remain inactive. No automated tests or actual game compatibility verification. Local artifact evidence is separate from portable checked-in source.
